prompt: A reusable workflow declares a required `deploy-key` secret. A caller wants to forward everything it can see without naming secrets one by one. Which call does that?
explanation: `secrets: inherit` forwards every secret the calling workflow can see, in place of an explicit name-by-name map. Nothing is passed implicitly: without `inherit` or explicit names, the called workflow sees none of the caller’s secrets.

options.text: Nothing — a called workflow receives all caller secrets automatically
